title: Rival drummer Oscar Bradley and Lee's model Baby Lewis
summary: Lee describes Lorenzo Flournoy's band at the Alabam and drummer Oscar Bradley who copied Lionel Hampton while Lee modeled himself on Baby Lewis.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Lorenzo Flournoy is a name that keeps coming up. Did he have a band or a trio or what? I know he had a trio in later years.

Yeah, well he did have a trio later, but at first, he used to have a band at the Alabam; he had about 8 pieces, and Doetsie Williams was in it, and there was a very good drummer here in town that he and I were really, really competitors, because we were around the same age -- I think he may have been 2 or 3 years older than I was. His name was Oscar Bradley, and the guy was really -- he was a good drummer. We had different styles. I patterned myself kind of at the time, as I told you, about the drummer with Buck Clayton -- his name was Lewis -- remember I told you about the left handed drummer?
And Oscar patterned himself after Lionel

Hampton. Lionel Hampton was with Les Hyte's band, and -- Baby Lewis, and when they had the battle of the bands at the Alabam, you know, Oscar was really looking at Lionel and I was looking at Baby Lewis, but they were both what I would call flashy drummers, you know -- they'd twirl the sticks and throw the sticks, and Baby Lewis was more the type of drummer that I thought that I wanted to be, and so ...

But Oscar was quite good. As a matter of fact, when I got the job at the staff of the studio, I thought really in my heart -- I really thought at the time that Oscar was probably better prepared than I was for it, you know, this is what being a drummer, he had more experience, and I really thought that he was better prepared than I was for it, but it didn't quite turn out that way, because you know, I started getting all the mallets ballads together. Well, he didn't play mallets ballads at all, but I really did think that at the time.
